meaning:
ἀσσάριον, -ον, τό
(diminutive of Lat. as),
an assarion, a farthing, one-tenth of a drachma: Mat.10:29, Luk.12:6 (MM, see word; DB, iii, 428; DCG, ii, 200).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will,
“Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
